label: Breitkopf Brahms 1 pp.0-3 — the WHOLE far-from-an-end population, against the print
what: Every solo (head, stroke) pair in the shipped record whose head centre sits more than 0.8 head-heights from the nearer end of the stroke — the complete population, 8 of them — plus 8 at-an-end pairs as a CONTROL, shuffled together.
question_put_to_each_tile: Does one END of the BLUE stroke lie at the RED head, or does the stroke run past the head on both sides?
blind: Tiles carry an opaque id (G00..G15) only. Stratum and gap were not read until every verdict below was written.
NOT_independent: One adjudicator, who also wrote the crop tool. No inter-rater figure. The red box is the record's own notehead box, so the tile shows where the pipeline thinks the head is.

vocabulary.head_at_an_end: an end of the stroke lies within, or immediately at, the head
vocabulary.head_part_way_along: stroke ink extends clearly beyond the head on BOTH sides
vocabulary.cannot_tell: could not decide from the strip
